errors.generic: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.noPermission: Your role isn’t allowed to change these settings.

payments.title: Payment methods
payments.description: Choose which payment methods customers can pick for Pickup (prepared now) and Schedule Delivery (booked ahead). Card payments are collected by you at handoff with your own reader — nothing is charged online yet. Orders your staff take at the counter or POS are not affected.
payments.dineInNote: This covers delivery and pickup only. Dine-in customers skip the payment step entirely and settle with you at the restaurant.

cash.label: Cash
cash.hint: Paid to the driver or at the counter

card.label: Card
card.hint: Collected at handoff with your own reader

transfer.label: QR transfer
transfer.hint: Customer scans your QR, transfers, and uploads the slip for you to approve

payments.lockedTransfer: Upload your QR code below to enable
payments.cardLocked: Card payment is not included in your current package.
payments.noMethod: {which, select, asap {Pickup (now) orders have no payment method enabled — customers won’t be able to place delivery or pickup orders that way.} scheduled {Schedule Delivery orders have no payment method enabled — customers won’t be able to place delivery or pickup orders that way.} other {Pickup (now) and Schedule Delivery orders have no payment method enabled — customers won’t be able to place delivery or pickup orders either way.}} Dine-in is not affected.

qr.title: Your QR code
qr.description: Customers see this at checkout, transfer the total, then upload a photo of the slip. Nothing is charged automatically — the order waits in Orders until you approve the slip.
qr.accountNamePlaceholder: Name shown on your bank account
qr.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Include your order number in the transfer note
qr.onWithoutImage: QR transfer is switched on but no QR image is saved. Customers will be refused at checkout until you upload one.
qr.savedButOff: Your QR code is saved but QR transfer is still switched off, so customers cannot choose it. Tick it under Pickup (now) and/or Schedule Delivery above, then save.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Distance-based pricing, delivery radius, and dispatch behavior for this branch. Distances and per-distance rates are in miles.

radius.label: Delivery radius (mi)
radius.hint: Orders beyond this distance are rejected at checkout. Above ~50 mi, raise “Driver max pay” too or drivers are capped at $50 no matter how far they drive.

surgeFrom.label: Surge starts at (mi)
surgeFrom.hint: Below this distance the multiplier is not applied at all. 0 surges every order, including a half-mile hop.

prepTime.label: Prep time (min)
prepTime.hint: Baseline kitchen time used in customer ETAs

searchRadius.label: Driver search radius (mi)
searchRadius.hint: How far from the branch to look for drivers. Set it very high to reach every driver (useful when testing dispatch).

maxAttempts.label: Max dispatch attempts
maxAttempts.hint: Staff get alerted after this many failed rounds. Set it very high to keep retrying (useful when testing dispatch).

gpsAge.label: Max rider GPS age (min)
gpsAge.hint: How stale a last known rider location may be and still be offered work. Raise it while testing — riders only send GPS while the app is open in the foreground.

offerTimeout.label: Offer timeout (sec)
offerTimeout.hint: How long a driver has to accept an offer

stackDetour.label: Stacked-order max detour (mi)
stackDetour.hint: Pair two ready orders only when the second is on the way — this caps the extra driving the second customer accepts. Lower = only near-perfect same-route pairs (needs stacking enabled below)

maxPay.label: Driver max pay ($)
maxPay.hint: Hard ceiling on what one delivery can pay a driver, before tips. Must be raised alongside a large delivery radius, or long runs are truncated to this amount.

pause.label: Pause new orders
pause.hint: Customers see the branch as closed until you resume.

stacking.label: Stack same-route orders (งานพ่วง)
stacking.hint: When two orders are ready together and the second is on the same route (little extra driving), offer both to one driver as a single trip. Each order still pays the driver in full.

busy.label: Busy mode — extra prep time (min)
busy.hint: Added to every customer ETA while the kitchen is slammed. 0 = off.

surge.title: Surge pricing
surge.description: Charges more for the long deliveries that cost more to run, and leaves short ones alone.
surge.multiplierHint: 1.00 = off, and nothing below is charged extra.
surge.off: Surge is off — every order is charged base + per-mile.
surge.on: Under {distance} mi: base + per mile. From {distance} mi: ×{multiplier} on the whole fee.
surge.unreachable: This multiplier never applies: it starts at {distance} mi, and nothing past your {radius} mi delivery radius can be ordered. Lower the surge distance or raise the radius.

preview.title: Fee preview
preview.footnote: Sample distances picked from your own surge distance and delivery radius, priced by the same formula the storefront and the order server use.

deliveryHours.title: Delivery

platform.title: Favornoms drivers
platform.body: Orders are offered to nearby riders automatically. They pick up, navigate and mark the order delivered.

self.title: We deliver ourselves
self.body: No rider is called. Your own staff take the order out and mark it picked up and delivered from the Live deliveries screen.

deliveryHours.selfNote: Customers still see live status updates, but not a map — nothing is reporting a position while your own staff are driving.
deliveryHours.limitHint: Off: deliveries can be booked for any time the branch is open. On: customers can only book delivery times inside the windows below. Every delivery is booked ahead, so delivery also needs Scheduled orders switched on.
deliveryHours.armedButEmpty: Delivery hours are switched on but no windows are set — customers cannot place a delivery order at all. Add a window, or switch this off.

scheduling.title: Scheduled orders
scheduling.description: How customers book deliveries: on your storefront every delivery is booked for a day and time, and pickup is always ordered for now. Bookable times start from this branch’s Opening hours above, narrowed by the booking windows below when you switch those on, and by Delivery hours when those are limited. A branch that does not sell delivery takes no bookings from customers.
scheduling.acceptHint: Customers book every delivery for a day and time. Off: “Schedule Delivery” disappears from your storefront and customers can only order Pickup.
scheduling.minLeadHint: How far in advance a customer must book. Slots sooner than this are not offered.
scheduling.slotHint: Rounds the offered times. Bigger slots mean fewer, tidier choices.
scheduling.kitchenLeadHint: A booking stays out of the kitchen display until this long before its time. This is not the prep time shown in customer ETAs — that stays on the Delivery card.
scheduling.leadGap: Customers can book {bookMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} ahead, but you asked for {kitchenMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} of kitchen notice. Anything booked inside that gap reaches the kitchen straight away, with less notice than you wanted. Raise Earliest booking to match if that matters.
scheduling.limit: Limit the times customers can book
scheduling.limitHint: Off: customers can book any time the branch is open. On: only inside the windows below — set a different one per day, so you can take bookings from 5pm all week and only 10am–2pm on Sunday.
scheduling.closedDuringWindows: nothing — the branch is closed during these hours
scheduling.armedButEmpty: Booking windows are switched on but none are set — customers cannot schedule an order at all. Add a window, or switch this off.

serviceFee.title: Service fee
serviceFee.description: A percentage of the food subtotal, charged only when the customer pays by credit / debit card. Cash, QR transfer and dine-in orders never pay it. Set it to 0 to charge no service fee at all.
serviceFee.label: Service fee (%)
serviceFee.hint: 0 – {max}%. Card payments only. Charged on the subtotal — never on tax, tips or the delivery fee.
serviceFee.cardLocked: Card payment is not included in your current package, so this fee is never charged right now.

tips.title: Tips
tips.description: How each tip is split between the worker and the house. On delivery the worker is the driver; on pickup and dine-in it’s the staff pool.
tips.share: {worker, select, driver {Driver share} other {Staff pool share}}
tips.split: {worker, select, driver {{workerPct}% driver · {housePct}% house} other {{workerPct}% staff pool · {housePct}% house}}
tips.example: {worker, select, driver {On a $10 tip: driver ${workerCut}, house ${houseCut}.} other {On a $10 tip: staff ${workerCut}, house ${houseCut}.}}
